title: Standpipes.
officialText:
Standpipes shall be individually trapped. Standpipes shall extend a minimum of 18 inches (457 mm) and a maximum
of 42 inches (1067 mm) above the trap weir. Access shall be provided to all standpipes and drains for rodding.
SECTION PC 803
SPECIAL WASTES
